payload.title: One grouping and ordering rule for every list, in core
payload.description:
Why: Machines on Machines redraws section groups and concept order by parsing rendered HTML (_group_references, _most_connected_first and similar). Articles and Posts sections are placed by most recent update while Videos and Findings are placed by best item, which is inconsistent. Core should do both, once.
Includes existing PPY-6a3735 (section names in the projection), PPY-c63f18 (ranked concept views) and PPY-3d26a0 (recency buckets); stories below add only what those do not cover. Ends with a p.apyr.us page.
Done when: MoM can delete its regex redraws and its golden renders are unchanged.
